items.title: The OptinCraft – Drag & Drop Optins & Popup Builder for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'order_by' parameter in all versions up to,...
items.summary: The OptinCraft – Drag & Drop Optins & Popup Builder for WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'order_by' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.2.0 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

llm_summary.summary_zh: OptinCraft – Drag & Drop Optins & Popup Builder 是一款用于 WordPress 的弹窗和表单构建插件。在其所有版本（包括 1.2.0）中，由于对用户提供的 'order_by' 参数转义不足，且未对现有 SQL 查询进行充分预处理，存在通用 SQL 注入漏洞。该漏洞允许具有管理员级别及以上权限的认证攻击者，通过修改 'order_by' 参数向原有查询中追加额外的 SQL 语句，从而从数据库中提取敏感信息。攻击方式为网络攻击，无需用户交互，但需要管理员权限。成功利用此漏洞可能导致数据库中的用户凭据、配置信息等敏感数据泄露。建议受影响站点立即升级到最新版本（如果存在修复版本），同时限制管理员的网络访问权限，并监控数据库异常查询。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞虽然需要管理员权限，但攻击者一旦获取管理凭证即可利用 SQL 注入窃取整个数据库内容，对网站安全构成严重威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 认证攻击者（管理员及以上权限）可通过 SQL 注入提取数据库中的敏感信息，如用户密码哈希、密钥等。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞虽然需要管理员权限，但攻击者一旦获取管理凭证即可利用 SQL 注入窃取整个数据库内容，对网站安全构成严重威胁。

items.title: The EmbedPress – PDF Embedder, Embed PDF viewer, YouTube Videos, 3D FlipBook, Social feeds & more plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the block...
items.summary: The EmbedPress – PDF Embedder, Embed PDF viewer, YouTube Videos, 3D FlipBook, Social feeds & more plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the block 'url' attribute in all versions up to, and including, 4.5.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page

llm_summary.summary_zh: EmbedPress是一款WordPress插件，提供PDF嵌入、视频、3D翻页书等功能。该插件在4.5.3及之前的所有版本中，其区块的'url'属性存在存储型跨站脚本（Stored XSS）漏洞。由于对用户输入的数据过滤不严且输出时未正确转义，具有贡献者及以上权限的认证攻击者可以向页面注入任意Web脚本。当其他用户访问受影响的页面时，注入的脚本会执行，可能导致信息泄露、会话劫持或恶意操作。CVSS评分为6.4，属于中等严重性，攻击复杂度低，需要低权限但影响范围可波及所有用户。建议用户立即升级到4.5.4或更高版本，禁用受影响的区块功能，并限制对WordPress后台的访问权限。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许拥有贡献者等低权限的攻击者存储恶意脚本，任何访问包含恶意页面的用户都可能受影响，广泛影响使用该插件的WordPress站点安全。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 成功利用可导致信息泄露、会话劫持、页面篡改，严重时可能被用于进一步传播恶意软件或控制用户账户。

items.title: The Essential Addons for Elementor – Popular Elementor Templates & Widgets plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 6.6.4...
items.summary: The Essential Addons for Elementor – Popular Elementor Templates & Widgets plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 6.6.4 via the ajax_load_more function due to insufficient restrictions on which posts can be included. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to extract data from password protected, private, or draft posts that they should not have access to.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于WordPress插件Essential Addons for Elementor（流行模板与小部件）所有版本至6.6.4（含）中。通过ajax_load_more函数，由于对可包含的文章限制不足，未认证攻击者能够利用信息泄露漏洞提取本应受保护的密码保护、私有或草稿文章的数据。该漏洞影响范围广泛，攻击者无需任何权限即可利用，但仅能获取受限文章的内容，无法修改或删除。CVSS评分为5.3（中等），属于信息泄露类型。建议用户立即将插件更新至最新版本，同时考虑在网络层面（如Web应用防火墙）添加针对ajax_load_more功能的访问控制规则，以缓解潜在风险。目前未发现该漏洞已被在野利用的证据。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: WordPress广泛使用该插件，漏洞使未认证攻击者可绕过访问控制读取密码保护或私有文章，可能泄露敏感内容。虽然CVSS仅5.3，但利用简单且影响多个版本。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可读取日志、配置或隐藏文章中的敏感信息，可能导致隐私泄露或后续攻击铺垫。

items.title: The LearnPress – Backup & Migration Tool plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 4.1.4 via deserialization of untrusted ...
items.summary: The LearnPress – Backup & Migration Tool plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in all versions up to, and including, 4.1.4 via deserialization of untrusted input . This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to inject a PHP Object. No known POP chain is present in the vulnerable software, which means this vulnerability has no impact unless another plugin or theme containing a POP chain is installed on the site. If a POP chain is present via an additional plugin or theme installed on the target system, it may allow the attacker to perform actions like delete arbitrary files, retrieve sensitive data, or execute code depending on the POP chain present.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-7566 是一个影响 WordPress LearnPress – Backup & Migration Tool 插件（版本 ≤ 4.1.4）的 PHP 对象注入漏洞。攻击者可以通过反序列化不可信输入来注入任意 PHP 对象。该漏洞需要攻击者拥有管理员及以上权限才能利用，但若目标系统上安装了其他包含 POP 链的插件或主题，则可能允许攻击者执行任意文件删除、敏感数据窃取或代码执行等操作。由于漏洞本身不包含已知的 POP 链，因此其实际影响取决于环境。CVSS 评分为 6.6（中等），属于高危中等级别。建议用户立即升级到最新版本以修复漏洞，并限制管理员账户的使用，避免不必要的权限授予。同时，审计已安装的插件和主题，防止 POP 链被利用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许管理员权限的攻击者在特定条件下实现远程代码执行或敏感数据窃取，虽然需要额外的 POP 链组件，但风险不容忽视。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许管理员权限的攻击者在特定条件下实现远程代码执行或敏感数据窃取，虽然需要额外的 POP 链组件，但风险不容忽视。

items.title: The LearnPress – Backup & Migration Tool plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Read via Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 4.1.4 via the 'i...
items.summary: The LearnPress – Backup & Migration Tool plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Read via Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 4.1.4 via the 'import-user-file' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to read the contents of arbitrary files on the server, which can contain sensitive information.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-7565 涉及 WordPress 插件 LearnPress – Backup & Migration Tool 版本 4.1.4 及之前版本中的一个任意文件读取漏洞。该漏洞源于对 'import-user-file' 参数的处理不当中存在目录遍历，允许具有管理员级及以上权限的认证攻击者读取服务器上的任意文件，其中可能包含敏感信息，例如数据库凭据、配置文件等。漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 4.9（中等），攻击复杂性低，无需用户交互，但需要高权限。目前未见该漏洞被列入已知利用漏洞目录（KEV）或在野利用的证据。建议受影响的用户立即将插件升级到最新版本，并限制管理员账号的访问权限，确保仅授权人员可访问后台管理界面，同时监测异常的文件读取行为。对于无法立即升级的情况，可考虑暂时禁用该插件或对相关功能实施严格的输入验证。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许拥有管理员权限的攻击者读取服务器上的任意文件，可能导致敏感信息泄露，进而引发更严重的攻击。尽管利用需要高权限，但一旦被利用，危害较大。

items.title: The MDJM Event Management plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 1.7.8.3 via the mdjm_send_comm_email function. This i...
items.summary: The MDJM Event Management plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 1.7.8.3 via the mdjm_send_comm_email function. This is due to no file type, extension, or MIME type validation being performed on uploaded files. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with administrator-level access and above, to upload files that may be executable, which makes remote code execution possible.

llm_summary.summary_zh: MDJM Event Management 是一款 WordPress 活动管理插件。该插件 1.7.8.3 及之前版本中存在任意文件上传漏洞（CVE-2026-7537），源于 mdjm_send_comm_email 函数对上传文件未做任何文件类型、扩展名或 MIME 类型校验。具有管理员及以上权限的认证攻击者可以上传恶意可执行文件（如 PHP 脚本），从而在服务器上实现远程代码执行（RCE）。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分 7.2（高），影响机密性、完整性和可用性。由于 WordPress 站点部署广泛，且管理员账号可被高权限用户（如超级管理员）利用，一旦被攻击者结合社交工程或其它漏洞获取管理员权限，即可完全控制网站。目前厂商尚未发布补丁，但建议立即限制管理员权限，禁用文件上传功能（如非必要），并关注官方更新以升级至修复版本。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许已通过认证的 Administrator 上传任意文件，实现远程代码执行，可完全控制 WordPress 站点。由于管理员权限可被窃取或滥用，风险极高，需尽快修补。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许已通过认证的 Administrator 上传任意文件，实现远程代码执行，可完全控制 WordPress 站点。由于管理员权限可被窃取或滥用，风险极高，需尽快修补。

items.title: The Quick Playground plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Path Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.4. This is due to the `qckply_data()` function passing the us...
items.summary: The Quick Playground plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Path Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 1.3.4. This is due to the `qckply_data()` function passing the user-supplied `filename` POST parameter directly to `file_get_contents()` without any validation, sanitization, or path restriction. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with Administrator-level access and above, to read arbitrary files on the server, such as `wp-config.php` or `/etc/passwd`, which can contain sensitive information. Note: This vulnerability is only exploitable when the site has been synced with WordPress Playground (the `is_qckply_clone` option is set) or when running on `playground.wordpress.net`.

llm_summary.summary_zh: WordPress 的 Quick Playground 插件（版本 1.3.4 及之前）存在路径遍历漏洞。漏洞源于 `qckply_data()` 函数在处理用户提供的 `filename` POST 参数时，直接将其传递给 `file_get_contents()` 函数，而未进行任何验证、清理或路径限制。这使得具有管理员级别及以上权限的认证攻击者能够读取服务器上的任意文件，例如 `wp-config.php` 或 `/etc/passwd`，从而获取敏感信息。需要注意的是，该漏洞仅在站点已与 WordPress Playground 同步（即 `is_qckply_clone` 选项已设置）或在 `playground.wordpress.net` 上运行时才能被利用。CVSS 评分为 4.4（中等），攻击复杂度高，要求高权限，但无需用户交互，影响仅限机密性。目前该漏洞未被列入已知利用漏洞目录（KEV），也未有在野利用证据。建议受影响的用户尽快将插件升级到最新版本；若无法立即升级，应限制管理员账户的访问权限，并检查是否启用了不必要的 Playground 同步功能。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许具有管理员权限的攻击者读取服务器任意文件，可能导致敏感数据泄露，如数据库凭据和系统配置文件。尽管利用条件受限（需同步Playground），但仍需及时修复以降低风险。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可以读取任意文件，包括 WordPress 配置文件 (wp-config.php) 包含数据库凭证，或系统文件 (如 /etc/passwd)，导致敏感信息泄露。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 立即更新 Quick Playground 插件到最新版本（如果可用）；若无法更新，考虑禁用该插件或限制管理员账号的使用。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许具有管理员权限的攻击者读取服务器任意文件，可能导致敏感数据泄露，如数据库凭据和系统配置文件。尽管利用条件受限（需同步Playground），但仍需及时修复以降低风险。
items.recommended_action: 立即更新 Quick Playground 插件到最新版本（如果可用）；若无法更新，考虑禁用该插件或限制管理员账号的使用。

items.title: The Page-list plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Missing Authorization in all versions up to, and including, 6.2. This is due to the pagelist_unqprfx_ext_shortcode() function...
items.summary: The Page-list plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Missing Authorization in all versions up to, and including, 6.2. This is due to the pagelist_unqprfx_ext_shortcode() function (the [pagelist_ext] / [pagelistext] shortcode) accepting attacker-controlled post_status, post_type, and show_meta_key attributes and passing them directly into get_pages() and get_post_meta() with no capability check verifying that the rendering user is permitted to read the matched objects. When the current post has no child pages, the shortcode re-issues the query with child_of => 0, broadening it to every page on the site matching the supplied status/type. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to disclose the titles, body content/excerpts, and arbitrary post meta of unrelated private and draft pages by inserting the shortcode into a contributor-authored draft and previewing it.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于 WordPress 的 Page-list 插件（版本 ≤ 6.2）中，属于授权缺失（Missing Authorization）。问题源于 `pagelist_unqprfx_ext_shortcode()` 函数（对应短代码 `[pagelist_ext]` / `[pagelistext]`）在处理用户输入的 `post_status`、`post_type` 和 `show_meta_key` 属性时，未对当前用户进行适当的权限检查，直接将攻击者控制的参数传递给 `get_pages()` 和 `get_post_meta()` 函数。正常情况下，短代码应仅列出当前文章的子页面；但当当前文章没有子页面时，代码会重置查询条件为 `child_of => 0`，从而检索整个站点中符合指定状态/类型的页面。这使得拥有贡献者及以上权限的认证攻击者，可以通过在自己创建的草稿中插入该短代码并预览，泄露站内其他私有或草稿页面的标题、正文/摘要内容以及任意文章元数据（post meta）。攻击者无需特殊权限，仅需贡献者角色即可利用。该漏洞未涉及在野利用，但鉴于其利用难度低（需认证且低权限），影响范围广（可泄露敏感内容），建议立即升级插件至最新版本（或修补版本作为临时缓解），同时限制贡献者角色的短代码使用权限。官方尚未发布补丁，需要关注插件更新。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许低权限攻击者（贡献者）无需特殊技巧即可泄露站内所有未公开页面的内容及元数据，导致敏感信息暴露。WordPress 站点中贡献者是常见角色，攻击面广，且插件广泛使用，影响严重。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 认证攻击者（贡献者及以上）可利用该漏洞读取 WordPress 站点上任意私有或草稿页面的标题、正文/摘要以及自定义字段（post meta），造成敏感信息泄露。CVSS 评分 4.3，属于中等风险，但实际业务影响取决于站内内容敏感度。

items.title: The Integration for Freshsales – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor, Gravity Forms and More plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Form Submission...
items.summary: The Integration for Freshsales – Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor, Gravity Forms and More plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Form Submission Data in all versions up to, and including, 1.0.15 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected payload only executes when a CRM API call fails for the submitted form and an administrator subsequently views the error log details modal in the WordPress admin panel.

llm_summary.summary_zh: CVE-2026-8901 影响 WordPress 的 Integration for Freshsales 插件（版本 ≤ 1.0.15），该插件用于将 Contact Form 7、WPForms、Elementor、Gravity Forms 等表单与 Freshsales CRM 集成。漏洞存在于表单提交数据处理过程中，由于对用户输入的数据缺乏充分的输入清理和输出转义，导致存储型跨站脚本（Stored XSS）漏洞。未经身份验证的攻击者可以通过提交特制的表单数据，在管理员查看错误日志详情时触发任意 Web 脚本执行。具体来说，只有当表单提交导致 CRM API 调用失败，且管理员随后在 WordPress 后台查看错误日志详情模态框时，注入的载荷才会执行。攻击者可以窃取管理员会话 cookie、重定向用户、修改页面内容或执行其他恶意操作。该漏洞的 CVSS 评分为 7.2（高），影响范围为网络攻击面，无需用户交互（PR:N, UI:N），且影响机密性和完整性。目前无证据表明该漏洞已被在野利用，也未列入已知利用漏洞目录（KEV）。建议用户立即将插件升级到 1.0.16 或更高版本，以修复输入验证和输出转义问题。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞允许未认证攻击者在 WordPress 管理后台执行存储型 XSS，可能窃取管理员权限、篡改网站内容，严重影响站点安全。插件广泛用于表单集成，攻击面大。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可利用存储型 XSS 在管理员查看错误日志时执行任意脚本，导致会话劫持、恶意重定向、数据窃取或进一步权限提升。

items.why_it_matters: 该漏洞允许未认证攻击者在 WordPress 管理后台执行存储型 XSS，可能窃取管理员权限、篡改网站内容，严重影响站点安全。插件广泛用于表单集成，攻击面大。

items.title: The LatePoint – Calendar Booking Plugin for Appointments and Events plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery in all versions up to, and including, 5.6.0....
items.summary: The LatePoint – Calendar Booking Plugin for Appointments and Events plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery in all versions up to, and including, 5.6.0. This is due to missing or incorrect nonce validation on the change_status function. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to change the status of arbitrary invoices — including marking unpaid invoices as paid — without administrator consent via a forged request granted they can trick a site administrator into performing an action such as clicking on a link.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该漏洞存在于WordPress的LatePoint日历预订插件（Appointments and Events）中，影响所有版本直至5.6.0（含）。问题源于change_status函数缺少或未正确实现nonce验证，导致跨站请求伪造（CSRF）攻击。未认证的攻击者可通过诱骗站点管理员点击恶意链接或访问恶意页面，伪造请求任意更改发票状态，包括将未付款发票标记为已付款。此漏洞允许攻击者绕过授权，干扰正常的支付流程。CVSS评分为4.3（中等），攻击向量为网络，无需认证，但需要用户交互（管理员点击链接）。影响仅涉及完整性（低），不涉及机密性和可用性。建议管理员立即将插件升级到最新版本（5.6.0之后），以修复nonce验证缺失的问题。由于是WordPress插件，攻击面较广，但利用条件需要管理员交互，紧急程度中等。无需限制网络暴露，但应谨慎处理未知链接。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 攻击者可利用CSRF伪造管理员操作，将未支付发票标记为已支付，导致财务损失和业务逻辑混乱。影响大、利用简单，需及时打补丁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可在无授权情况下更改任意发票状态，将未付款发票标记为已付款，破坏支付流程的完整性。

items.title: The RSS Aggregator by Feedzy – Feed to Post, Autoblogging, News & YouTube Video Feeds Aggregator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to...
items.summary: The RSS Aggregator by Feedzy – Feed to Post, Autoblogging, News & YouTube Video Feeds Aggregator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 5.1.7. This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to create and execute RSS import jobs, purge (force-delete) all posts associated with any import job, clear import error logs, and enumerate taxonomy terms and post meta_key names. The nonce required to reach these sub-handlers is leaked to any user with the edit_posts capability via the feedzyjs localized script injected into the block editor, meaning no privileged nonce theft or separate exploit step is required for Contributor-level users.

llm_summary.summary_zh: The RSS Aggregator by Feedzy – Feed to Post, Autoblogging, News & YouTube Video Feeds Aggregator 是一款WordPress插件，用于RSS聚合和自动博客发布。该插件在5.1.7及之前所有版本中存在授权绕过漏洞。漏洞根因是插件未能正确验证用户是否有权执行特定操作，导致认证攻击者（至少拥有贡献者级别权限）能够：创建和执行RSS导入作业、强制删除与任何导入作业关联的所有文章、清除导入错误日志、以及列举分类项和文章元数据键名。更关键的是，用于访问这些子处理器的nonce被泄露给了任何拥有edit_posts能力的用户（通过注入到块编辑器中的feedzyjs本地化脚本），这意味着贡献者级别用户无需额外的权限提升或漏洞利用步骤即可触发漏洞。CVSS评分为4.3（中等），攻击复杂度低，需要低权限，但只影响完整性（低）。尽管目前EPSS（漏洞利用预测评分系统）无数据，且未收录在已知被利用漏洞目录（KEV）中，也没有在野利用报告，但考虑到插件广泛使用且漏洞利用条件较低，建议用户立即升级到最新版本（如5.1.8或更高），并审查当前已授予的贡献者及以上角色权限，对非必要账号限制插件相关功能。此外，可考虑通过Web应用防火墙（WAF）规则或禁用高风险功能临时缓解风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该插件拥有超过20万活跃安装，漏洞允许低权限认证用户执行未授权操作，可能导致数据损坏或信息泄露，虽非远程代码执行，但利用门槛低，需及时修复。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 攻击者可利用该漏洞绕过授权检查，创建恶意RSS导入作业、批量删除文章、清除日志、枚举分类和元数据键，造成网站数据破坏或信息泄露。

items.title: WebMCP Tool Surface Poisoning: Runtime Manipulation Attacks on LLM Agents
items.summary: WebMCP is a newly emerging protocol that enables websites to expose tools directly to AI agents, bypassing traditional user interfaces and introducing new security risks. The dynamic exposure of agent-accessible tools in WebMCP expands the attack surface of web sessions, especially when third-party scripts are involved. In this study, we identify a new potential threat, termed Mid-Session Tool Injection (MSTI), in which attackers leverage third-party scripts to inject malicious tools during an active session. To better characterize this threat, we classify MSTI based on the stage and target of manipulation, distinguishing between Tool Hijacking and Tool Framing. Tool Hijacking modifies the set of tools visible to the agent through mechanisms such as the AbortSignal API or race conditions during tool registration. In contrast, Tool Framing influences the agent's perception of tool roles through metadata fields such as tool name, description, readOnlyHint, and inputSchema. Our implementation demonstrates that both Tool Hijacking and Tool Framing can successfully disrupt the intended functionality of WebMCP. Based on these results, we outline potential mitigation directions and provide security design recommendations for WebMCP, including binding tool identity to its origin, ensuring lifecycle consistency, enforcing data boundaries for third-party tools, and maintaining traceable logs of tool registration and invocation. These findings indicate that MSTI arises from WebMCP's unique tool lifecycle and structured metadata, making the tool surface itself an emerging security concern.

llm_summary.summary_zh: WebMCP 是一种新兴协议，允许网站直接将工具暴露给 AI 代理，绕过传统用户界面，从而引入新的安全风险。本文针对 WebMCP 协议提出了一种新的攻击类型——会话中工具注入（Mid-Session Tool Injection, MSTI）。攻击者利用第三方脚本，在活跃会话期间将恶意工具注入到 AI 代理的工具列表中，从而操纵代理的行为。作者进一步将 MSTI 细分为两种子类：Tool Hijacking（工具劫持）和 Tool Framing（工具框架）。Tool Hijacking 通过利用 AbortSignal API 或工具注册时的竞争条件，修改代理可见的工具集合；Tool Framing 则通过操控工具元数据字段（如名称、描述、readOnlyHint 和 inputSchema）来影响代理对工具角色的理解。实现证明表明，两种攻击均能成功破坏 WebMCP 的正常功能。基于这些发现，作者提出了若干缓解方向和安全设计建议，包括：将工具的身份绑定到其来源、确保生命周期一致性、强制执行第三方工具的数据边界、以及维护工具注册和调用的可追溯日志。该研究揭示了 WebMCP 特有的工具生命周期和结构化元数据导致了工具表面本身成为一个新兴的安全关注点。读者群体包括 LLM 代理安全研究人员、WebMCP 开发者以及 AI 系统安全工程师。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: WebMCP 是连接 AI 代理与 Web 服务的新兴协议，本文首次系统分析其工具表面的安全性，揭示了会话中工具注入这一新型攻击向量，对构建安全的 LLM 代理生态系统具有重要警示意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 威胁使用 WebMCP 协议的 LLM 代理系统，可能导致代理执行恶意操作或泄露敏感数据；攻击面扩展至任何集成第三方脚本的 Web 页面。

items.title: Description-Code Inconsistency in Real-world MCP Servers: Measurement, Detection, and Security Implications
items.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has emerged as a critical standard empowering Large Language Models (LLMs) to utilize external tools. In this ecosystem, LLMs rely on natural language descriptions provided by MCP servers to select and execute functions. This interaction implicitly assumes that tool descriptions faithfully reflect their underlying implementations, while this assumption is not mandatorily verified in practice. As a result, MCP deployments may suffer from a problem named Description-Code Inconsistency (DCI), where a tool's description of its capabilities and security boundaries is not consistent with what the code actually does. In this paper, we present a comprehensive study of DCI in real-world MCP servers. We formally define the problem and propose a comprehensive taxonomy spanning functionality inconsistencies and undeclared side effects. Guided by this taxonomy, we develop DCIChecker, an automated framework that combines structure-aware static analysis with the Direct-Reverse-Arbitration prompting method to cross-validate tool descriptions against actual code implementations. We apply this framework to a large-scale dataset comprising 19,200 description-code pairs extracted from 2,214 real-world MCP servers. Our measurement reveals that DCI is widespread, with 9.93% of these pairs exhibiting inconsistencies. We further demonstrate that DCI creates a critical defense blind spot, facilitating varied risks from operational failures to stealthy malicious behaviors. Finally, we propose mitigation strategies to enforce semantic consistency and enhance the reliability of the emerging agentic ecosystem.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）与外部工具交互的关键协议——模型上下文协议（MCP）中的描述-代码不一致（DCI）问题进行了系统性研究。在MCP生态中，LLM依赖工具的自然语言描述来选择和执行函数，但该描述与底层代码实现之间的一致性并未得到强制验证，从而产生安全盲区。作者首先正式定义了DCI问题，并提出了包含功能不一致和未声明副作用两类的全面分类法。基于此分类，他们开发了DCIChecker自动化框架，该框架结合了结构感知静态分析和直接-反向-仲裁（Direct-Reverse-Arbitration）提示方法，交叉验证工具描述与实际代码实现。研究团队将该框架应用于大规模数据集，从2,214个真实MCP服务器中提取了19,200个描述-代码对。测量结果显示DCI普遍存在，9.93%的对存在不一致。进一步实验表明，DCI可导致从操作故障到隐蔽恶意行为等多种风险。最后，作者提出了强制语义一致性、增强新兴代理系统可靠性的缓解策略。本文适合AI安全、LLM应用安全及协议设计领域的研究者与工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次对MCP协议中描述与代码不一致问题进行大规模测量，揭示了LLM工具调用机制中的重要安全盲区，直接关系到AI代理的安全性与可靠性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有基于MCP的LLM应用，包括工具选择错误、权限绕过、数据泄露等；风险可迁移至任何依赖自然语言接口的代理系统。
detection_signals_zh: 工具描述与实际代码逻辑存在差异（如参数范围、副作用、权限声明）
静态分析发现代码中存在描述未声明的文件操作、网络请求或系统调用
使用DCIChecker框架进行交叉验证可检测不一致
defense_advice_zh: 强制要求MCP服务器提供描述与代码的一致性验证
部署自动化工具（如DCIChecker）定期审计描述-代码对
建立描述与代码的自动同步机制，减少人工编写偏差

items.title: When Autoregressive Consistency Hurts Safety Alignment
items.summary: Safety alignment in large language models (LLMs) is fragile in part because it is often shallow: fine-tuning mainly reshapes the model's behavior near the first few output tokens. We argue that this phenomenon can be understood through autoregressive consistency, the tendency of next-token prediction to preserve and extend the current response trajectory consistently. By analyzing the learning dynamics of safety alignment, we show that autoregressive consistency can concentrate alignment updates on early tokens, offering a mechanistic explanation for shallow safety alignment. The same mechanism also predicts a broader class of attacks on LLMs: attacks that induce harmful continuation states at arbitrary positions in the output trajectory. As a concrete example, we introduce random insertion attack, which inserts a short harmful span into an otherwise safe refusal trajectory and exploits autoregressive consistency to sustain the resulting harmful branch, thereby bypassing safety alignment. Notably, a short harmful span can redirect the generation to be harmful even after a long refusal prefix, highlighting autoregressive consistency as a potential broader failure mechanism. This suggests that safety alignment should also break harmful autoregressive consistency throughout the output trajectory. We therefore propose adversarial safety alignment, an initial framework based on worst-case harmful continuation states, and instantiate it with random worst-insertion training. Overall, our results suggest that autoregressive consistency should be treated as a central consideration in both safety alignment and attack design.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）安全对齐的脆弱性，提出其根本原因在于自回归一致性——即自回归模型在预测下一个token时倾向于保持并延续当前生成轨迹的特性。作者通过分析安全对齐微调的学习动态，发现对齐更新主要集中在输出序列的前几个token上，导致安全对齐呈现“浅层”现象：模型仅在早期响应中拒绝有害请求，而后续生成可能偏离安全轨迹。这一机制也预测了一类更广泛的攻击：攻击者可以在输出轨迹的任意位置诱导一个有害的“连续状态”（harmful continuation state），从而劫持生成过程。作为具体示例，本文提出了随机插入攻击（random insertion attack），该方法在原本安全的拒绝回复中插入一个简短的有害片段（例如几个有害词），利用自回归一致性使模型延续该有害分支，即使之前已有大量拒绝前缀也能成功绕过安全对齐。实验表明，即使插入片段很短，也能使模型产生有害输出，凸显了自回归一致性作为更广泛失败机制的可能性。基于以上发现，作者提出对抗性安全对齐（adversarial safety alignment）框架，通过考虑最坏情况下的有害连续状态来训练模型，并实例化为随机最坏插入训练（random worst-insertion training）。总体而言，本文揭示了自回归一致性在安全对齐和攻击设计中的核心地位，为理解LLM安全脆弱性提供了新的理论视角，并为防御策略改进指明了方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文首次从自回归一致性的动力学角度解释了LLM安全对齐浅层化的根本原因，并据此预测并验证了一种新型攻击（随机插入攻击），同时提出了对抗性安全对齐的防御框架。对安全从业者而言，理解这一机制有助于设计更鲁棒的对齐方法和评估现有防御的局限性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响LLM安全对齐的评估与防御策略开发，可迁移至任何基于自回归生成的AI系统（如对话、代码生成等），尤其对需要长期一致性的安全拒绝场景有重要警示意义。

items.title: From Attack Simulation to SIEM Rule: Deterministic Detection-as-Code Synthesis with Probe-Level Traceability
items.summary: Security teams routinely simulate attacks against their own systems to check whether their monitoring would catch a real intruder. These Breach-and-Attack-Simulation (BAS) tools surface findings, but the security information and event management (SIEM) systems that watch production need detection rules -- and today a human bridges that gap by hand, reading each finding and writing the corresponding Sigma rule (a vendor-neutral detection format). We show this translation can be partially automated when probes are drawn from a locked corpus, so each finding carries a stable identifier back to the originating probe. We describe a deterministic synthesis function that maps each finding to a starter Sigma rule through a small template library (N=23, indexed by categories from the OWASP LLM and Web Top 10), with a back-reference to the originating finding and its MITRE ATT&CK technique. On two locked corpora (17-probe LLM, 23-probe Web), every bypassed-probe finding yields a starter rule, and all 17/17 emitted rules parse and convert to Splunk and Elasticsearch backends. Replayed through a live OpenSearch SIEM, the LLM rules fire on 30% of a held-out AdvBench subset and 14% of HarmBench at 7.7% false positives on a benign baseline; the Web side is validated structurally, not against a held-out attack set. The contribution is a verifiable, byte-stable path from BAS finding to operator-deployable starter rule, re-derivable from the published corpus and template library alone -- trading the breadth of LLM-generative methods for exact reproducibility and a typed traceback from any fired alert to the originating probe.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种确定性的检测即代码合成方法，旨在将攻防模拟（Breach-and-Attack-Simulation, BAS）工具产生的发现结果自动转换为SIEM可用的检测规则。当前安全团队通常手动为每个发现编写Sigma规则（一种厂商中立的检测格式），流程耗时且易出错。作者利用锁定探测语料库（locked corpus）中每个探针携带的稳定标识符，实现从发现结果到Sigma规则的可复现映射。具体方法包括一个小型模板库（共23个模板，分别索引自OWASP LLM和Web Top 10分类），根据发现结果所属类别选择模板，并填充参数以生成起始规则。每条规则均包含指向原始发现和MITRE ATT&CK技术的后向引用。在两组锁定语料（17个LLM探针和23个Web探针）上测试，所有被绕过的探针发现均能生成起始规则，且生成的17条LLM规则和23条Web规则均能成功解析并转换为Splunk和Elasticsearch后端格式。进一步在实时OpenSearch SIEM上回放测试，LLM规则在AdvBench子集上触发率达30%，在HarmBench上为14%，同时在良性基线上的误报率为7.7%；Web规则仅进行了结构验证。主要贡献在于提供了一条可验证、字节稳定的从BAS发现到可部署起始规则的路径，且仅需发布语料库和模板库即可完全复现，相比于LLM生成方法牺牲了广度但获得了精确的可复现性和从任何报警到原始探针的类型化追溯。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 这项研究为安全运营团队提供了一种自动化、可复现的检测规则生成方法，减少人工编写Sigma规则的负担，并确保每条规则可追溯至原始探针，提升检测规则的透明度和可信度。

items.title: An Embarrassingly Simple Detector for Model Extraction Attacks in Large Language Model API Traffic
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed through hosted APIs, making model extraction a practical threat to model ownership and service security. However, individual extraction queries often resemble benign requests, and existing evaluations often focus on single-query anomaly scoring or pure benign-versus-attacker user settings. We formulate model extraction monitoring as benign-calibrated traffic-window distribution testing and show that an embarrassingly simple detector is effective: embed incoming queries into a semantic space and test whether their aggregate distribution deviates from historical benign traffic. We instantiate the detector with maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), using only benign-vs-benign comparisons to set the decision threshold. We evaluate on fourteen attacker-normal query pairs from four extraction scenarios and compare with adapted PRADA, SEAT, CAP, DATE, and marginal Mahalanobis baselines. Across three random seeds, MMD achieves 0.3% benign FPR, 100.0% pure-attacker TPR, 90.5% average TPR over attacker fractions, and 95.1% balanced accuracy. These results show that benign-calibrated distribution testing is a strong empirical baseline for model extraction detection in both user-level and mixed multi-user LLM API traffic. Code is released at: https://github.com/LabRAI/mmd-llm-mea-detection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对大型语言模型（LLM）以API形式部署时面临的模型提取攻击（Model Extraction Attacks）威胁，提出了一种异常简洁但有效的检测方法。背景上，模型提取攻击指攻击者通过向LLM API发送精心设计的查询，试图重建或窃取目标模型的功能或参数，从而威胁模型所有者和服务安全。现有检测方法多关注单查询异常得分，或在纯良性vs纯攻击者用户场景下评估，难以应对混合多用户流量中攻击查询与正常查询相似的问题。本文作者将模型提取监控重新定义为一种基于良性校准的流量窗口分布测试问题：将传入查询嵌入到语义空间中，然后测试其聚合分布是否偏离历史良性流量。具体实现采用最大均值差异（MMD）作为分布差异度量，仅通过良性vs良性比较来设定决策阈值，避免了需要攻击样本。实验选取了四种提取场景下的十四个攻击者-正常查询对，并与PRADA、SEAT、CAP、DATE及边际马氏距离等基线方法对比。结果显示，MMD检测器在三个随机种子上实现了0.3%的良性误报率、100%的纯攻击者检测率、攻击者混合比例下的90.5%平均检测率以及95.1%的平衡准确率。研究表明，这种良性校准的分布测试方法在用户级别和混合多用户LLM API流量中均能作为模型提取检测的强基线。代码已开源。本文适合安全研究人员、LLM服务提供商以及关注AI模型安全防护的工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM模型提取攻击威胁日益严重，现有检测方法复杂且效果有限。本文提出的基于MMD的检测器极度简单、无需攻击样本即可部署，在多种场景下达到近乎完美的检测率，为API安全防护提供了直接可用的基线方法。

items.title: SecRL-Prune: Structured Reinforcement Learning-Based Pruning of CodeLLMs for Preserving Adversarial Code Mutation
items.summary: Large code language models (CodeLLMs) can generate and rewrite programs, enabling functionality-preserving code mutation that may be used to create diverse malware variants and evade signature-based detection. A key security question is whether this mutation capability survives model compression, which would make deployment feasible under limited hardware budgets. We propose SecRL-Prune, a structured pruning framework for CodeLLMs that operates on feed-forward (MLP/FFN) channels. Starting from a pretrained teacher, it learns a layer-wise pruning policy with reinforcement learning using a teacher-student KL-divergence reward. To improve efficiency, we cache the teacher's top-P predictions once and compare the pruned student against this compact target, avoiding simultaneous teacher-student residency in GPU memory. We evaluate SecRL-Prune on HumanEval using pass@k for execution correctness and var@k for code diversity across three 7B CodeLLMs at 10-30% compression. SecRL-Prune consistently preserves higher pass@k and var@k than recent structured pruning baselines under aggressive pruning. In a case study on real malware samples, semantics-preserving mutations from 20%-pruned models substantially reduced detections. These results show that code mutation capability can survive significant structured pruning, highlighting the security relevance of compressed CodeLLMs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出 SecRL-Prune，一种针对代码大型语言模型（CodeLLM）的结构化剪枝框架，旨在研究在模型压缩后是否仍能保持其对抗性代码变异能力。大型代码语言模型能够生成和改写程序，实现功能保持的代码变异，这可能被用于创建多样化的恶意软件变体以规避基于签名的检测。关键安全问题是这种变异能力是否能在模型压缩后幸存，从而在有限硬件预算下实现部署。SecRL-Prune 基于预训练教师模型，通过强化学习学习逐层剪枝策略，使用教师-学生 KL 散度作为奖励。为提高效率，它缓存教师模型的前 P 个预测，并将剪枝后的学生模型与该紧凑目标进行比较，避免同时将教师和学生模型保留在 GPU 内存中。在 HumanEval 基准上，使用 pass@k（执行正确性）和 var@k（代码多样性）对三种 7B 参数规模的 CodeLLM 在 10-30% 的压缩率下进行评估。结果表明，在激进剪枝下，SecRL-Prune 始终比近期结构化剪枝基线保持更高的 pass@k 和 var@k。在真实恶意软件样本的案例研究中，20% 剪枝模型生成的语义保留变异显著减少了检测率。这些结果表明代码变异能力可以在显著的结构化剪枝后幸存，凸显了压缩后 CodeLLM 的安全相关性。适合安全研究人员、LLM 开发者和红蓝队关注。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了压缩后的 CodeLLM 仍然可能被用于生成对抗性代码变异，威胁基于签名的检测，对安全部署大模型有重要警示。

items.title: Steering LLM Viewpoints through Fabricated Evidence Injection
items.summary: As chatbots increasingly influence daily decision-making, their potential to produce misleading responses poses substantial risks to users. This paper investigates a critical cognitive vulnerability in LLMs: their tendency to uncritically trust external context when presented with fabricated evidence bearing markers of credibility. We introduce Ghostwriter, a two-phase attack framework that first repackages misleading statements with fabricated rationales, then instruct target LLMs to incorporate these viewpoints when responding to relevant queries. Experiments on BBQ, ToxiGen, and our specialized dataset reveal that commercial LLMs without external safety classifiers remain highly vulnerable, while even frontier classifier-guarded models (e.g., GPT-5.4) reduce but do not eliminate the attack. Building on this, we explore multiple defense strategies, among which a tailored safety policy enables gpt-oss-safeguard to achieve 81% detection rate.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究聚焦于大型语言模型（LLM）在对话系统中的应用，发现其存在一种关键认知脆弱性：当外部上下文包含伪造但看似可信的证据时，LLM会不加批判地信任该上下文。作者提出了名为 Ghostwriter 的两阶段攻击框架：第一阶段将误导性陈述与伪造的理由重新包装；第二阶段指示目标LLM在回答相关查询时采纳这些观点。在 BBQ、ToxiGen 及作者自建数据集上的实验表明，未部署外部安全分类器的商业LLM极易被攻击，即使是使用前沿分类器防护的模型（如 GPT-5.4）也只能降低成功率而无法完全消除威胁。进一步，作者探索了多种防御策略，其中一种定制安全策略使 gpt-oss-safeguard 达到了81%的检测率。本文揭示了 LLM 对伪造证据的信任倾向，为构建更安全的对话系统提供了重要警示与防御思路。

items.title: GenTI: Benchmarking LLMs for Autonomous IDPS Rule Generation for Unseen Attacks
items.summary: Rule-based Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems (IDPS) offer precise attack detection as well as mitigation, however their manually crafted, signature-driven rules limit adaptability to emerging and zero-day threats. Additionally, existing public datasets (e.g., CICIDS2017, UNSW-NB15) focus on traffic classification and provide little structured information to support automatic rule synthesis or prevention logic. To address this gap, we propose Generative Thread Intelligence (GenTI) \footnote{GenTI refers to the proposed framework, and GTI refers to the dataset.} an LLM-driven benchmark for automatic generation of IDPS rules targeting unseen attacks. The dataset (GTI) aggregates over 150k detection and prevention rules from Snort, Suricata, Emerging Threats, as well as 50k YARA, each annotated with protocol behavior, payload signatures, contextual relationships, mappings to Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), along with actionable response types (alert, drop, reject). Moreover, on top of this corpus we design an LLM-based pipeline that transforms analyst prompts and representative payloads into deployable rules via structured prompt engineering, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, as well as a Chain-of-Verification (CoVe) loop for syntactic, semantic, and security validation. The generated rules are executed in real time on (Snort/Suricata) and evaluated by syntax accuracy, semantic similarity, CTI coverage, security effectiveness as well as unseen attacks detection. Furthermore, our GenTI instantiation achieves a composite rule-quality score of 89.4\%, with 94.8\% CTI coverage, improving unseen attacks detection from 45\% to 87.4\% and reducing the false-positive rate from 8.5\% to 2.3\%. Overall, GenTI establishes the first large-scale benchmark that tightly couples rule-level CTI with LLM-based automation, enabling adaptive, self-evolving IDPS.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 论文《GenTI: Benchmarking LLMs for Autonomous IDPS Rule Generation for Unseen Attacks》由 Hassan Jalil Hadi 等人撰写，旨在解决基于规则的入侵检测与防御系统（IDPS）对新兴及零日威胁适应性不足的问题。现有基于签名的规则依赖人工编写，难以自动应对未知攻击；同时，公共数据集（如 CICIDS2017、UNSW-NB15）主要用于流量分类，缺乏结构化信息来支持规则自动合成。为此，作者提出了生成式威胁智能（GenTI）框架——一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的基准测试，用于自动生成针对未见攻击的 IDPS 规则。该框架包含一个名为 GTI 的大规模数据集，整合了超过 15 万条来自 Snort、Suricata、Emerging Threats 的检测与防御规则，以及 5 万条 YARA 规则，每条规则都标注了协议行为、载荷签名、上下文关系、网络威胁情报（CTI）映射以及可操作的响应类型（alert、drop、reject）。在此基础上，GenTI 设计了一套基于 LLM 的流水线，通过结构化提示工程、思维链（CoT）推理以及链式验证（CoVe）循环（用于语法、语义和安全验证），将分析师提示和代表性载荷转化为可部署的规则。生成的规则在 Snort/Suricata 上实时执行，并从语法准确性、语义相似度、CTI 覆盖、安全有效性以及未见攻击检测率等方面进行评估。实验表明，GenTI 实例的规则质量综合得分为 89.4%，CTI 覆盖率达到 94.8%，未见攻击检测率从 45% 提升至 87.4%，假阳性率从 8.5% 降至 2.3%。总体而言，GenTI 建立了首个将规则级 CTI 与 LLM 自动化紧密结合的大规模基准，支持自适应、自演进的 IDPS。

items.title: Membrane: A Self-Evolving Contrastive Safety Memory for LLM Agent Defense
items.summary: Despite advances in safety alignment, large language models remain vulnerable to continuously evolving jailbreaks. Existing fine-tuned safety classifiers cannot adapt to these evolving attacks, while adaptive memory-based guardrails tend to over-refuse benign queries that resemble stored attacks. We propose Membrane, a self-evolving guardrail built on Contrastive Safety Memory (CSM): each cell pairs the conditions for blocking a harmful query with those for permitting a superficially similar benign request. Without retraining, Membrane evolves CSM by distilling each harmful interaction and its benign counterpart into a contrastive cell indexed by the underlying attack strategy, so that one cell generalizes across topical variants of the same mechanism. At inference, retrieved cells serve as grounding context for precise safety decisions. Across model-level safety on HarmBench and agent-level safety on AgentHarm, Membrane achieves the highest F1 on all six jailbreak attacks. Notably, benign refusal on AgentHarm stays at 7-14%, well below the 28-85% range of prior guards. Memory cells also retain 87-88% F1 under cross-attack transfer and remain stable under memory poisoning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 论文提出了Membrane，一种针对大型语言模型（LLM）代理的自我进化防御机制，旨在解决现有安全对齐方法无法适应持续演变的越狱攻击的问题。核心创新在于对比安全记忆（Contrastive Safety Memory, CSM）结构：每个记忆单元存储一个对比对，即阻止某个有害查询的条件与允许一个表面相似的良性查询的条件。Membrane无需重新训练，通过将每次有害交互及其良性对应物蒸馏为一个对比单元，并依据底层攻击策略进行索引，使得单个单元能够泛化到同一机制的不同主题变体。在推理时，检索到的单元作为安全决策的上下文依据，实现精确的拒绝或放行。实验在模型级安全基准HarmBench和代理级安全基准AgentHarm上进行，Membrane在六种越狱攻击上均取得最高F1分数。特别地，在AgentHarm上良性查询的误拒率仅为7-14%，远低于先前防护方法的28-85%。记忆单元在跨攻击迁移时仍保持87-88%的F1，且对记忆投毒攻击具有鲁棒性。该工作适合LLM安全研究人员、红队和防护系统开发者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Membrane提供了一种无需重训练即可自适应越狱攻击演变的轻量级防护方案，显著降低了良性误拒率，对保障LLM代理在实际场景中的可用性和安全性具有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于对话系统、自动化工具、API代理等LLM驱动的服务，提升对新兴越狱攻击的防御能力，同时保持低误报。

items.title: SlotGCG: Exploiting the Positional Vulnerability in LLMs for Jailbreak Attacks
items.summary: As large language models (LLMs) are widely deployed, identifying their vulnerability through jailbreak attacks becomes increasingly critical. Optimization-based attacks like Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) have focused on inserting adversarial tokens to the end of prompts. However, GCG restricts adversarial tokens to a fixed insertion point (typically the prompt suffix), leaving the effect of inserting tokens at other positions unexplored. In this paper, we empirically investigate \emph{slots}, i.e., candidate positions within a prompt where tokens can be inserted. We find that vulnerability to jailbreaking is highly related to the selection of the \emph{slots}. Based on these findings, we introduce the \textit{Vulnerable Slot Score} (VSS) to quantify the positional vulnerability to jailbreaking. We then propose SlotGCG, which evaluates all slots with VSS, selects the most vulnerable slots for insertion, and runs a targeted optimization attack at those slots. Our approach provides a position-search mechanism that is attack-agnostic and can be plugged into any optimization-based attack, adding only 200ms of preprocessing time. Experiments across multiple models demonstrate that SlotGCG significantly outperforms existing methods. Specifically, it achieves 14\% higher Attack Success Rates (ASR) over GCG-based attacks, converges faster, and shows superior robustness against defense methods with 42\% higher ASR than baseline approaches. Our implementation is available at \href{https://github.com/youai058/SlotGCG}{https://github.com/youai058/SlotGCG}

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）在面对越狱攻击时的位置脆弱性。传统的基于优化的攻击方法（如贪婪坐标梯度下降 GCG）通常将对抗性 tokens 固定在提示语的末尾，忽略了在其他位置插入 tokens 的潜在影响。作者首先通过实验发现，提示语中不同的 token 插入位置（称为“槽位”）对越狱攻击的脆弱性高度相关。基于此，他们提出了脆弱槽位评分（VSS）来量化每个位置对越狱攻击的脆弱性。进一步，他们设计了 SlotGCG 方法：先使用 VSS 对所有候选槽位进行评估，选择最脆弱的槽位；然后在这些选定槽位上执行有针对性的优化攻击。SlotGCG 是一种攻击无关的位置搜索机制，可无缝集成到任何基于优化的攻击方法中，仅增加约 200 毫秒的预处理时间。在多个模型上的实验表明，SlotGCG 显著优于现有方法：与 GCG 基线相比，攻击成功率（ASR）提升 14%，收敛速度更快，且对防御方法的鲁棒性更强（ASR 比基线高 42%）。代码已开源。该工作揭示了 LLM 提示中位置维度的安全风险，为越狱攻击提供了新的研究视角。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了 LLM 提示中不同位置对越狱攻击的脆弱性差异，提出新的攻击优化方法，对理解模型安全隐患和设计防御策略有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能降低现有 LLM 部署的安全性，使越狱攻击更高效、更难防御；同时为防御方案（如输入位置扰动、动态加噪）提供对抗用例。

items.title: ZERO-APT: A Closed-Loop Adversarial Framework for LLM-Driven Automated Penetration Testing under Intelligent Defense
items.summary: LLM-driven automated penetration testing agents are typically evaluated against static targets that neither detect nor respond to attacks, so their behavior under intelligent defense remains untested. The causal consistency of multi-step attack chains likewise hinges on unstable LLM reasoning, and agent decisions remain opaque to human analysts. These three shortcomings, in realism, consistency, and auditability, are usually patched in isolation. We present ZERO-APT, a turn-based attacker-defender-judge framework that addresses them within a single architecture. For realism, ZERO-APT embeds a configurable LLM Defender that consumes Sysmon telemetry and detects attacks in real time, exposing the attacker to a live opponent rather than a passive target. For consistency, three architectural mechanisms move causal consistency from unstable LLM reasoning into enforced system architecture: separation of planning from execution, multi-dimensional ReAct feedback, and a hard-constraint-filtered action library. For auditability, a dedicated Judge agent adjudicates each round, maintains global state, and emits structured post-hoc CTI reports that make every decision traceable. We evaluate a Windows Server 2022 post-exploitation prototype across five scenarios with three Defender configurations. ZERO-APT reaches 79\% attack success rate (Aurora 22\%, PentestGPT 39\%), a Causal Consistency Score of 0.860 (Aurora 0.930, Claude Code 0.520), and end-to-end decision auditability through structured CTI reports. We release the benchmark to support evaluation of penetration agents under intelligent defense.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出ZERO-APT，一个面向LLM驱动的自动渗透测试智能体的闭环对抗框架。现有评估通常在静态目标上进行，目标既不检测也不响应攻击，导致智能体在智能防御下的行为未经测试。此外，多步攻击链的因果一致性依赖于不稳定的LLM推理，且智能体决策对分析师不透明。ZERO-APT通过一个回合制的攻击者-防御者-裁判框架同时解决这三个问题：真实性方面，嵌入可配置的LLM防御者，利用Sysmon遥测实时检测攻击，使攻击者面对活对手而非被动目标；一致性方面，通过规划与执行分离、多维ReAct反馈、硬约束过滤动作库三种机制将因果一致性从不稳定LLM推理转移到强制系统架构中；可审计性方面，专用裁判智能体裁决每轮行动、维护全局状态并生成结构化事后CTI报告，使每个决策可追溯。在Windows Server 2022后渗透原型上，使用三种防御者配置评估五个场景，ZERO-APT达到79%攻击成功率（对比Aurora 22%、PentestGPT 39%），因果一致性得分0.860（Aurora 0.930、Claude Code 0.520），并通过结构化CTI报告实现端到端决策可审计。作者发布了基准测试以支持智能防御下的渗透智能体评估。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次在统一框架中同时评估LLM渗透智能体面对智能防御的真实性、因果一致性和可审计性，为开发更鲁棒的自动化渗透测试工具提供了重要基准和方法。

items.title: GuardNet: Ensemble Strategies of Shallow Neural Networks for Robust Prompt Injection and Jailbreak Detection
items.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing, but they remain vulnerable to Prompt Injection (PI) and Jailbreak (JB) attacks. In addition, benchmark evaluations may be affected by contamination and partial information leakage, compromising performance estimates. This work presents GuardNet, a guardrail system based on an ensemble of shallow neural networks (BiLSTMs) with approximately 47 million parameters. We investigate the hypothesis that robustness in adversarial scenarios depends more on the diversity of example coverage and threshold calibration than on model scale. The results indicate that GuardNet achieves competitive performance compared with lightweight detectors and high efficiency at low latency, although larger LLMs such as Mistral-7B and Llama-3.1-8B still achieve superior performance in terms of F1 score and AUROC on the blind JBB-Behaviors benchmark. Nevertheless, GuardNet achieves an AUROC of 0.747 on the blind dataset (n = 200) and an F1 score of 0.92 on a proprietary benchmark (n = 50), under threshold calibration and evaluation with declared partial information leakage. The system operates with an average latency of approximately 50 ms on CPU, making it suitable for deployment in production environments with cost and infrastructure constraints.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在自然语言处理领域取得了突破，但仍面临提示注入（Prompt Injection, PI）和越狱攻击（Jailbreak, JB）的严重威胁。现有基准评测可能受到数据污染和部分信息泄露的影响，导致性能估计不准确。本文提出 GuardNet，一种基于浅层神经网络（BiLSTM）集成的护栏系统，模型参数约 4700 万。研究假设：对抗场景下的鲁棒性更多依赖于示例覆盖的多样性和阈值校准，而非模型规模。实验结果表明，GuardNet 在盲测数据集 JBB-Behaviors（n=200）上 AUROC 达到 0.747，在专有基准（n=50）上 F1 分数达 0.92（在阈值校准和已声明的部分信息泄露条件下）。尽管 Mistral-7B 和 Llama-3.1-8B 等更大模型在 F1 和 AUROC 上仍更优，但 GuardNet 在 CPU 上平均延迟仅约 50 毫秒，非常适合成本和基础设施受限的生产环境部署。文章详细介绍了集成策略、阈值校准方法以及部分信息泄露对评测的影响，为轻量级防御系统提供了新思路。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 低延迟、轻量级的提示注入/越狱检测方案对实际部署至关重要，GuardNet 展示了在有限资源下仍能保持较好检测能力，适合安全运营团队集成到 LLM 应用防护中。

items.title: SHIELDS: Automating OS Hardening with Iterative Multi-Agent Remediation
items.summary: Security misconfigurations remain a leading cause of OS-level compromise, and manually keeping systems compliant with standards like Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) is a tedious and expensive process. Existing compliance automation tools can reduce some of this burden, but they depend on static, pre-written corrective actions. In this paper, we introduce SHIELDS, a multi-agent system that uses large language models (LLMs) to approach OS hardening as an iterative, feedback-driven process. Instead of applying fixed remediations, SHIELDS continuously proposes fixes and refines them based on feedback from target system execution and validation scans. We evaluate the system across multiple virtual machine configurations using six contemporary LLMs ranging from 20B to 400B parameters, and find that SHIELDS successfully remediates up to 73% of scan findings. Our results also suggest that success in this setting depends less on model size (parameter count) than on effective tool use and information gathering, paving a practical path toward reducing the burden of security compliance in environments where compute is limited or security and privacy needs drive local model use.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文提出了 SHIELDS，一个基于多智能体和大语言模型的自动化操作系统加固系统。针对安全配置错误这一导致系统被攻破的主要原因，传统方法依赖人工或静态预定义的修复脚本，效率低下且难以适应多样化环境。SHIELDS 将操作系统加固建模为一个迭代的、反馈驱动的过程：系统由多个 LLM 驱动的智能体组成，首先扫描目标系统以发现不符合 DISA STIGs 等安全基线的问题，然后自动生成修复方案并执行，接着重新扫描验证修复效果，若未完全修复则根据反馈调整修复策略，直到达到预期合规状态。实验在多种虚拟机配置上进行，使用了 6 种不同规模（20B 至 400B 参数）的当代 LLM。结果表明，SHIELDS 平均能修复高达 73% 的扫描发现的问题，并且修复成功率与模型参数规模相关性较弱，而更依赖于智能体能否有效利用工具和处理信息。这表明在计算资源受限或对数据隐私要求高的环境中，使用较小模型也能取得良好效果，为降低安全合规维护成本提供了新路径。主要贡献在于：1）提出了一种无需预设修复脚本的迭代加固框架；2）通过多智能体协作实现了自适应的修复策略生成；3）揭示了模型大小并非决定安全自动化效果的关键因素。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 传统 OS 加固依赖人工或静态脚本，难以规模化。SHIELDS 提供了一种基于 LLM 的自动化迭代方案，可显著降低安全配置管理的成本和复杂度，且不依赖大模型，适合资源受限或隐私敏感环境。

items.title: CRESS: Quantifying Vulnerabilities of Attack Scenarios in Hardware Reverse Engineering
items.summary: The safety, security, and reliability of microelectronic systems depend on a trustworthy, secured supply chain and design flow. Globally distributed supply chains or unintentional design weaknesses leave the door open for attacks on the hardware level. These scenarios encompass counterfeiting, hardware trojans, or on-device attacks. For these, hardware reverse engineering (RE) results play a pivotal role. The ongoing publication of new RE-involved attacks motivated the development of the common RE scoring system (CRESS). The system enables a general classification of RE-involved scenarios for a common, consistent rating. In this work, the originally qualitative system is extended to a quantitative system. We performed an extensive interview study with experts in the field. The interview results allowed us to derive weights that measure the severity of different RE-involved attack categories. The weights form an equation that quantifies scenarios, resulting in the severity-indicating CRESS score. The score enables the coherent rating of novel scenarios, renders them comparable, and supports the development of effective countermeasures. To showcase the effectiveness of the quantitative CRESS Score, six selected case studies are rated qualitatively and quantitatively. The CRESS Score proves to be significantly more expressive than the industry-standard Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了CRESS（Common RE Scoring System）的量化扩展版本，用于评估硬件逆向工程（RE）攻击场景的严重性。硬件逆向工程在微电子系统的安全中扮演关键角色，涉及假冒、硬件木马、设备上攻击等。现有的CVSS（Common Vulnerability Scoring System）行业标准在评估RE相关场景时表现不足，因为其设计初衷并非针对硬件RE。CRESS原本是一个定性分类系统，本文通过领域专家访谈研究，推导出不同RE攻击类别的权重，形成量化评分方程，从而得到CRESS分数。该分数能够对新型场景进行一致评级，使其具有可比性，并支持制定有效的防御措施。通过六个案例研究，定性和定量评估验证了CRESS分数的有效性，证明其比CVSS更具表达力。适合硬件安全研究人员、芯片设计安全工程师、供应链安全评估人员阅读。

items.title: Willing but Unable: Separating Refusal from Capability in Code LLMs via Abliteration
items.summary: Producing a labeled vulnerable code at scale is a recurring obstacle for learning-based vulnerability detection: mined corpora carry substantial label noise, and existing LLM-based augmentation propagates these inaccuracies because it transforms vulnerable seeds rather than synthesising vulnerabilities from a specification. A complementary route is to start from safe code and ask an instruction-tuned LLM to inject a specified CWE (which would shift the labeling burden from open-ended detection to bounded binary confirmation) but safety-aligned code LLMs systematically refuse such prompts. This paper is a preliminary feasibility study of abliteration, a low-rank weight edit that orthogonally projects out the refusal direction in the residual stream, as a tool to remove this barrier. We use Python and CWE-89 (SQL injection) as a case study, evaluating the Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct family at 3B, 7B, and 14B parameters on safe samples drawn from PromSec and SafeCoder, replicated three times per condition. We find that (i) refusal on injection prompts is strongly size- and prompt-context-dependent: the 14B refuses 100% of prompts, the 7B refuses 73% of PromSec but only 5% of SafeCoder, whereas the 3B is essentially never blocked; (ii) abliteration reduces refusal to zero or near-zero across all sizes while leaving syntactic validity above 93%, supporting the view that, in this setting, refusal can be detached from measured code-generation capability; and (iii) the post-abliteration injection rate remains capacity-bound (88-97% on the 14B, 89-90% on the 7B, and 25-48% on the 3B) separating willingness, which abliteration unlocks, from capability, which scales with parameters. Vulnerability verdicts are produced by a three-tool detector ensemble (CodeQL, Semgrep, Bandit) followed by manual adjudication by two authors on detector-positive outputs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对基于学习的漏洞检测中标记数据瓶颈问题，提出利用abliteration技术解除安全对齐代码LLM的拒绝响应限制，使其能够根据指定CWE（如SQL注入）从安全代码生成带漏洞样本，从而将标注负担从开放式检测转为有界二元确认。作者以Python和CWE-89为案例，在Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct模型系列（3B、7B、14B参数）上，使用PromSec和SafeCoder数据集进行三重复实验。研究发现：(i) 模型对注入提示的拒绝行为与大小和上下文密切相关：14B模型完全拒绝，7B在PromSec上拒绝73%但在SafeCoder上仅5%，3B几乎从不拒绝；(ii) ablitation（低秩权重正交投影去除残差流中的拒绝方向）可将拒绝率降至零或接近零，同时保持93%以上的语法有效性，表明在此场景下拒绝能力可与代码生成能力解耦；(iii) 注入率受限于模型容量：14B达88-97%，7B为89-90%，3B仅25-48%，揭示了ablitation解锁的是“意愿”而非“能力”。漏洞判定由CodeQL、Semgrep、Bandit三工具集成检测后经人工裁定。该研究为大规模高质量漏洞数据集生成提供了新方向。

items.title: SharedRequest: Privacy-Preserving Model-Agnostic Inference for Large Language Models
items.summary: With the widespread deployment of public large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, protecting user prompt privacy has become an increasingly critical issue. Existing privacy-preserving inference methods sacrifice either utility or efficiency, and often require model-specific modifications that limit their compatibility. In this paper, we propose SharedRequest, a model-agnostic framework for privacy-preserving LLM inference that reformulates privacy protection at the batch level rather than the individual-prompt level. The key idea is to obscure sensitive information by mixing original prompts with noisy variants, while grouping semantically equivalent instructions to amortize the inference cost over a large batch of queries with minimal impact on LLM response quality. This design is independent of the LLM architecture, requiring no access to model parameters or architectural modification. Empirical results demonstrate that SharedRequest achieves over $20\%$ higher utility compared to prior differential privacy baselines, and its shared-prompt mechanism reduces query cost by up to $5\times$ compared to non-batched inference.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 随着ChatGPT等大型语言模型（LLM）的广泛部署，用户提示的隐私保护成为一个关键问题。现有隐私保护推理方法要么牺牲效用，要么牺牲效率，且通常需要特定于模型的修改，限制了兼容性。本文提出SharedRequest，一个模型无关的隐私保护LLM推理框架，将隐私保护从单个提示级别重构为批处理级别。核心思想是通过将原始提示与噪声变体混合来混淆敏感信息，同时分组语义等价的指令，从而将推理成本分摊到大批量查询上，同时最小化对LLM响应质量的影响。该设计独立于LLM架构，无需访问模型参数或进行架构修改。实验结果表明，与先前的差分隐私基线相比，SharedRequest的效用提高了20%以上，其共享提示机制使查询成本比非批处理推理降低了5倍。该研究适用于所有需要保护用户查询隐私的LLM服务场景，尤其适合无法信任服务提供商的第三方应用。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究解决了LLM推理中用户提示隐私保护的实用性问题，提出的模型无关框架无需修改模型即可实现高效隐私保护，对推动隐私保护LLM服务落地有重要意义。

items.title: NLLog: Lightweight, Explainable SOC Anomaly Detection via Log-to-Language Rewriting
items.summary: System-generated logs underpin security monitoring, yet their rigid template-based format hinders both automated analysis and human comprehension. We present NLLog (Natural-Language Log), a lightweight pipeline that deterministically rewrites parsed templates into WHO-WHAT-SEVERITY sentences, pools them with term-frequency-inverse-document-frequency weighting, classifies sessions with tree ensembles, and back-projects evidence with TreeSHAP for analyst review. On Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS) and Blue Gene/L (BGL) corpora, NLLog exceeds two reproduced matched-protocol baselines; across HDFS, BGL, and the AIT Alert Data Set, it sustains low false-positive rates with commodity-hardware latency suitable for security operations center triage. Coverage, sparse-versus-dense, faithfulness, and adversarial ablations show that fallback sufficiency is corpus-dependent, that an enrollment-time coverage check can surface refinement requirements before deployment, and that an auditable deterministic rewrite combined with lightweight dense encoding provides a measurable representation layer for log-anomaly detection and triage.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为NLLog（自然语言日志）的轻量级异常检测管道，旨在解决系统日志因模板化格式导致自动化分析和人工理解困难的问题。NLLog通过确定性规则将解析后的日志模板重写为“谁-做了什么-严重程度”形式的自然语言句子，然后使用TF-IDF加权池化，利用树集成（如随机森林）对会话进行分类，并通过TreeSHAP回溯证据以支持分析师审查。在HDFS和Blue Gene/L (BGL)数据集上，NLLog超过了两个复现的匹配协议基线；在HDFS、BGL和AIT警报数据集上，它保持了较低的误报率，且延迟适合安全运营中心（SOC）的初步筛选。消融实验（覆盖度、稀疏与密集、忠实性、对抗性）表明，回退充分性依赖于语料库，注册时的覆盖度检查可在部署前发现优化需求，且可审计的确定性重写结合轻量级密集编码为日志异常检测与分类提供了可衡量的表示层。该研究适用于安全分析师、SOC工程师以及对日志分析自动化感兴趣的研究人员。

items.title: Sequential Data Poisoning in LLM Post-Training
items.summary: LLM post-training proceeds through multiple stages, e.g., supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) or direct preference optimization (DPO), where each stage draws data from different, potentially untrusted sources. Existing literature assumes data poisoning attacks may occur at each training stage, but neglects the possibility of multiple attackers. To study the trustworthiness of the entire post-training pipeline, we propose the threat model of sequential data poisoning, where multiple adversaries separately poison the SFT and preference datasets. Under this threat model, we identify the single-attacker illusion: each adversary, evaluated in isolation, appears to pose a negligible threat. Yet when adversaries collaborate across stages, the true vulnerability is revealed. In the SFT $\to$ DPO pipeline, their contributions are additive: splitting a fixed poison budget across stages outperforms concentrating it in either stage alone. In the SFT $\to$ PPO pipeline, their contributions are complementary: neither SFT nor reward model poisoning succeeds individually, yet their combination does. These findings show that security analyses of individual post-training stages systematically underestimate compound vulnerabilities that emerge only from their interaction. Code is available at https://github.com/jcksanderson/sequential-poisoning.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）后训练阶段中的顺序数据投毒威胁。LLM的后训练通常包括多个阶段，例如监督微调（SFT）和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）或直接偏好优化（DPO）。现有文献通常假设每个训练阶段可能发生数据投毒攻击，但忽略了多个攻击者协同攻击的可能性。为此，作者提出了一种新的威胁模型——顺序数据投毒，其中多个对手分别污染SFT数据集和偏好数据集。在这种模型下，作者发现了“单攻击者幻觉”：单独评估每个攻击者时，其威胁似乎微不足道；但当攻击者在不同阶段协作时，真正的脆弱性便会暴露。具体地，在SFT→DPO流水线中，攻击者的贡献是加性的：将固定投毒预算分散到多个阶段的效果优于集中在单一阶段。在SFT→PPO流水线中，攻击者的贡献是互补的：单独污染SFT或奖励模型都失败，但二者结合却能成功。这些发现表明，对单个后训练阶段的安全分析会系统性地低估仅在交互中出现的复合漏洞。论文提供了开源代码以复现实验。该工作对LLM安全部署具有重要警示意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了LLM后训练流水线中跨阶段数据投毒的复合漏洞，打破了单一阶段安全分析的幻觉，对安全从业者设计防御策略具有指导作用。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响任何采用多阶段后训练流程的LLM安全评估，可迁移至SFT、RLHF、DPO等场景。

items.title: TIBlender: Early-Warning Threat Intelligence from Cross-Platform Social Media Evidence
items.summary: Cyber threat signals are fragmented across multiple social media platforms, yet no existing approach has fully automated their integration into actionable threat intelligence (TI) reports. We present TIBlender, a multi-agent system that monitors four platforms (X, Reddit, Telegram, and Discord) and produces structured TI reports via role-specialized LLM agents. These agents conduct multi-perspective investigations, tracing chains of evidence to uncover related Indicators of Compromise (IoCs) via collaborative, evidence-backed analysis. In a real-world deployment, TIBlender detected emerging threats across all four threat categories ahead of public feeds, including in-the-wild exploitation ahead of public vulnerability registries; the majority of its IoCs were absent from each evaluated feed. Quantitative evaluation confirms that each platform contributes unique threat information unavailable from the others, and that excluding any single platform results in substantial loss of reports in specific threat categories. Under identical single-platform input conditions, TIBlender's IoC extraction meets or exceeds each baseline; the full pipeline surfaces substantially more IoCs, most of which are absent from any single-platform baseline. These results establish cross-platform social media monitoring as an effective and scalable early-warning layer for operational TI pipelines.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 TIBlender，一个基于多智能体系统的跨平台社交媒体威胁情报早期预警框架。当前，网络威胁信号分散在多个社交媒体平台（如 X、Reddit、Telegram 和 Discord），但现有方法未能完全自动化地将这些碎片化信息整合成可操作的威胁情报报告。TIBlender 通过角色专门化的 LLM 智能体（包括调查员、分析员等）进行多视角协作调查，追踪证据链以关联发现相关入侵指标（IoC），并利用证据驱动的分析生成结构化威胁情报。在真实部署中，TIBlender 在所有四种威胁类别（漏洞利用、恶意软件、钓鱼、僵尸网络）中均能比公开情报源更早检测到新兴威胁，例如在公共漏洞注册库之前发现正在被利用的漏洞；其报告中的大部分 IoC 在现有评估的情报源中均未出现。定量评估表明，每个平台都贡献了其他平台无法提供的独特威胁信息，排除任何一个平台都会导致特定威胁类别报告的大量损失。在相同的单平台输入条件下，TIBlender 的 IoC 提取能力达到或超过各基线模型；而完整的跨平台管道则能提取出更多 IoC，且多数 IoC 在任何单平台基线中均不存在。该研究证实了跨平台社交媒体监控作为运营威胁情报管道有效且可扩展的早期预警层的可行性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了一种自动化整合多源社交媒体碎片化威胁信号的方法，比现有情报源更早发现威胁，有助于 SOC 和蓝队抢占预警先机。

items.title: Search-Time Contamination in Deep Research Agents: Measuring Performance Inflation in Public Benchmark Evaluation
items.summary: Public benchmarks enable fair and reproducible evaluation of LLM reasoning, but they become fragile for deep research agents that actively search the web during inference. Such agents may retrieve public benchmark metadata, question context, or even ground-truth answers via web search. This gives rise to Search-Time Contamination (STC), where external retrieval bypasses intended reasoning and inflates measured performance. We systematically study STC in deep research agent evaluation. We define three contamination types with increasing severity, namely Benchmark Metadata Leakage, Question-Context Leakage, and Explicit Answer Leakage, and develop detection algorithms to identify them and quantify their impact on agent performance. Evaluating modern deep research agents on six public benchmarks, we find that STC is widespread and can inflate performance by up to 4%. Our findings show that existing evaluations may overestimate true reasoning ability. We therefore advocate contamination-aware practices, including isolated sandboxes, transparent search trajectories, and controlled benchmark access.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统性地研究了深度研究代理（Deep Research Agents）在公共基准测试中因搜索时间污染（Search-Time Contamination, STC）导致的性能评估失真问题。深度研究代理在推理时会主动进行网络搜索，从而可能无意中检索到基准测试的元数据、问题上下文甚至真实答案，绕过预期的推理过程，导致评估结果虚高。作者定义了三种污染类型，按严重程度递增：基准元数据泄露（Benchmark Metadata Leakage）、问题上下文泄露（Question-Context Leakage）和显式答案泄露（Explicit Answer Leakage），并开发了相应的检测算法来识别和量化污染对代理性能的影响。通过对现代深度研究代理在六个公共基准上的评估，发现STC普遍存在，可导致性能膨胀高达4%。研究结果表明，现有评估可能高估了代理的真实推理能力。因此，作者倡导采用污染感知的评估实践，包括隔离沙箱、透明的搜索轨迹和受控的基准访问。本文的主要贡献在于首次系统性地定义了搜索时间污染问题，提出了量化方法，并揭示了评估中的潜在偏差，对于LLM代理的可信评估具有重要启示。

items.title: What If Prompt Injection Never Left? Exploring Cross-Session Stored Prompt Injection in Agentic Systems
items.summary: Modern agentic systems transform LLMs from session-bounded assistants into stateful systems that persist and evolve shared world state across sessions through memories, filesystems, tools, and other long-lived contextual artifacts. This shift fundamentally expands the attack surface of prompt injection. However, prior works on prompt injection have largely focused on model-level threats within a single session, overlooking how cross-session persistent system state fundamentally changes the system-level risk of agentic systems. Inspired by stored cross-site scripting in web systems, we introduce cross-session stored prompt injection, where a successful injection can persist within agentic system state and silently influence future executions long after the original attacker interaction has ended. To systematically study this threat, we formalize stored prompt injection and develop a taxonomy of how adversarial content persists and affects agentic systems across sessions. We further develop a benchmark and sandbox toolkit to evaluate the risks of stored prompt injection, enabling quantitative analysis of attack success across different models, attack goals, and persistence channels. Our findings highlight that persistence transforms prompt injection from an ephemeral model-level threat into a long-lived system-level vulnerability embedded within agent execution state. We hope this work draws broader attention to this emerging threat and motivates the community to systematically study and mitigate system risks arising from persistence in agentic systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh:
该论文系统性地研究了新兴的跨会话存储提示注入（Cross-Session Stored Prompt Injection）威胁，这是针对现代 Agentic 系统（基于 LLM 的自主代理系统）的一种攻击范式。传统提示注入攻击通常局限于单个会话内部，攻击者通过构造恶意输入诱导 LLM 产生不安全行为。然而，Agentic 系统的核心特性在于其跨会话持久化状态——这些系统通过记忆（memory）、文件系统（filesystem）、工具（tools）以及其他长期存在的上下文工件（contextual artifacts）来维护和演化共享的世界状态。这种设计极大地扩展了提示注入的攻击面，使得一次成功的注入能够持久化地嵌入系统状态中，并在未来多次执行中持续产生影响，类似于 Web 安全中的存储型跨站脚本（Stored XSS）。
论文首先对存储提示注入进行了形式化定义，提出了一种分类法（taxonomy），系统梳理了对抗性内容如何通过不同持久化通道（如记忆、文件、数据库等）在 Agentic 系统中留存并影响跨会话行为。在此基础上，作者开发了一套基准测试（benchmark）和沙箱工具包，用于定量评估不同模型、攻击目标及持久化通道下的攻击成功率。实验结果表明，持久化机制将提示注入从一次性的、模型级的威胁转变为一种长期存在的、系统级的漏洞，攻击者可以远程植入恶意逻辑，在后续会话中静默操控 Agent 的行为，而无需持续交互。
这项工作适合安全研究人员、LLM 应用开发者以及 Agentic 系统架构师阅读，它揭示了持久化状态带来的新安全风险，并提供了评估框架，为后续防御研究奠定了基础。值得注意的是，该论文尚未提出具体防御措施，但深入分析了攻击机制和影响范围，属于前沿威胁分析类研究。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: Agentic 系统正快速落地，其跨会话持久化状态带来了全新的攻击面。本文首次系统性地定义并评估了存储提示注入，揭示其从瞬时威胁变为长期系统级风险的转变，对 LLM 安全架构设计具有里程碑式意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有依赖持久化上下文（记忆、文件、工具）的 LLM Agent 系统，如个人助理、自动化工作流、企业级 Agent 框架等。攻击可静默传播并影响后续所有交互，危害等级高。

items.title: Caught in the Act(ivation): Toward Pre-Output and Multi-Turn Detection of Credential Exfiltration by LLM Agents
items.summary: LLM agents often place sensitive credentials in the same context window as untrusted retrieved content, creating a direct path for indirect prompt injection to induce credential exfiltration. We study this failure mode through three complementary defenses. First, we ask whether activation probes can detect credential access before output tokens are emitted. Second, we construct honeytokens from format-specific character models and calibrate detection with split conformal prediction. Third, we treat multi-turn exfiltration as a cumulative information-flow problem and track an estimated leakage budget across conversation turns. In controlled experiments on open-weight models, activation features separate benign and credential-seeking prompts with high accuracy, including under held-out encoding transformations. In a small synthetic multi-turn suite, cumulative accounting detects attacks that per-turn detectors miss. These results are preliminary: the multi-turn benchmark is in-house and small, the activation method requires white-box access, and the information estimator provides a practical signal rather than a formal upper bound. Still, the results suggest that credential-exfiltration defenses should combine pre-output monitoring, calibrated canary detection, and temporal leakage accounting rather than relying only on text-level output filters.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文研究了LLM智能体在将敏感凭证与不受信任的检索内容置于同一上下文窗口时，面临的间接提示注入导致凭证泄露的风险。作者提出了三种互补的防御方法：首先，利用激活探针在输出令牌生成前检测凭证访问行为，在开源模型上实现了对良性提示与凭证窃取提示的高精度区分，且对编码变换具有鲁棒性；其次，构造基于格式特定字符模型的蜜令牌，并结合分裂共形预测校准检测阈值；第三，将多轮凭证泄露视为累计信息流问题，通过估计对话轮次间的泄漏预算来跟踪攻击，在小型合成多轮测试中，累计记账方法能够检测到单轮检测器遗漏的攻击。实验表明，组合使用预输出监控、校准蜜令牌检测和时间泄漏记账比仅依赖文本级输出过滤器更有效。但该研究仍处于初步阶段：多轮基准测试为内部小规模数据集，激活方法需要白盒访问，信息估计器提供的是实用信号而非形式化上界。论文面向AI安全研究人员、LLM应用开发者及防御工程师。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: LLM智能体广泛应用中，凭证泄露是新兴且高风险的攻击面，本研究提供了可落地的检测思路，帮助防御者提前识别并阻断攻击。

蜜令牌异常响应

defense_advice_zh: 部署预输出激活监控
在敏感接口嵌入格式化蜜令牌
记录并检测多轮对话中的信息泄漏总量

items.title: Agent libOS: A Library-OS-Inspired Runtime for Long-Running, Capability-Controlled LLM Agents
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from request-response assistants into long-running software actors: they maintain state across model calls, fork subtasks, wait for external events, request human authority, generate tools, and perform side effects that must be resumed and audited. This paper presents Agent libOS, a library-OS-inspired runtime substrate for LLM agents. Agent libOS runs above a conventional host operating system; it does not implement hardware drivers, kernel-mode isolation, or a POSIX-compatible operating system. Instead, it treats an agent as an AgentProcess: a schedulable execution subject with process identity, parent-child lineage, lifecycle state, a tool table derived from an AgentImage, typed Object Memory, explicit capabilities, human queues, checkpoints, events, and audit records. Its central design rule is tools are libc-like wrappers; runtime primitives are the authority boundary. Filesystem access, object access, sleeps, human approval, JIT tool registration, and external side effects are checked at primitive boundaries under explicit capabilities and policy. We describe the design, threat model, Python prototype, and safety-oriented evaluation. The current prototype implements async scheduling, namespace-local Object Memory, runtime-integrated human approval, one-shot permission grants, per-process working directories, shell and image-registration primitives, Deno/TypeScript JIT tools over a libOS syscall broker, filesystem/object bridge tools, an injectable Resource Provider Substrate, deterministic demos, real-model smoke scripts, and 123 regression tests at the time of writing. Rather than improving planner accuracy, Agent libOS demonstrates a runtime substrate in which long-running LLM agents can be scheduled, authorized, resumed, and audited without treating tool dispatch as the trust boundary.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对大型语言模型（LLM）代理从简单的请求-响应助手向长期运行的软件参与者演进的趋势，提出了一种名为Agent libOS的运行时系统。长期运行的LLM代理需要在模型调用之间维护状态、分叉子任务、等待外部事件、请求人类授权、动态生成工具并执行可能产生副作用的操作，这些行为必须能够被恢复和审计。然而，现有的代理架构通常将工具分发作为信任边界，缺乏足够的安全隔离和权限控制机制。受库操作系统（Library-OS）启发，Agent libOS运行在传统主机操作系统之上，但不实现硬件驱动、内核隔离或POSIX兼容操作系统。它引入了AgentProcess的概念，将每个代理视为一个可调度的执行主体，拥有进程标识、父子关系、生命周期状态、从AgentImage派生的工具表、类型化对象内存、显式能力（capabilities）、人类队列、检查点、事件和审计记录。其核心设计原则是：工具作为类似libc的包装器，而运行时原语（如文件系统访问、对象访问、睡眠、人类批准、JIT工具注册和外部副作用）则作为权限边界，在显式能力和策略下进行检查。论文详细描述了设计、威胁模型、基于Python的原型实现以及面向安全的评估。当前原型实现了异步调度、命名空间本地对象内存、运行时集成的人类批准、一次性权限授予、每进程工作目录、shell和镜像注册原语、通过libOS系统调用代理实现的Deno/TypeScript JIT工具、文件系统/对象桥接工具、可注入的资源提供者子系统和123个回归测试。Agent libOS并不旨在提高规划器的准确性，而是展示了一个运行时基底，使得长期运行的LLM代理可以被调度、授权、恢复和审计，而无需将工具分发视为信任边界。该工作为构建安全、可控的自主代理系统提供了系统级解决方案，尤其适用于需要长时间运行、权限分离和审计追踪的场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究从系统安全角度重新思考LLM代理的运行时设计，通过类操作系统进程模型和显式能力控制，有效解决了代理长期运行中的身份、状态、权限和审计问题，为构建安全可控的自主代理系统提供了重要参考。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于需要长时间运行、自主决策且需严格权限控制的LLM代理场景，如自动化运维、代码生成和多代理协作等。目前为原型研究，直接迁移需进一步开发。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，评估其设计理念是否可用于内部分布的代理框架或安全增强。

items.title: Large Language Models Hack Rewards, and Society
items.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant post-training paradigm, enabling large language models (LLMs) to learn from rewards. We observe that societal regulations are structurally similar to reward functions. They define measurable outcomes, thresholds, and exceptions, while often leaving institutional intent only partially specified. We hypothesise that the RL training process may exploit these gaps and therefore ask whether models' well-known tendency to hack reward functions during RL can scale into a more consequential failure mode named societal hacking: discovering loopholes in the rules society runs on. To study this phenomenon, we introduce SocioHack, a sandbox of 72 societal environments, and find that within these environments, reward hacking naturally emerges and leads to regulatory loophole discovery. Models learn to hack the social rules and generate strategies that remain technically compliant while defeating regulatory intent, and current LLM safeguards provide only limited mitigation. Therefore, collecting in-the-wild feedback for model training requires greater caution, and we need a next-generation post-training paradigm for safely iterating LLMs in real society.=

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）在强化学习（RL）后训练阶段中可能出现的“奖励黑客”（reward hacking）行为如何扩展到更广泛的社会层面，即“社会黑客”（societal hacking）。作者指出，社会规则与奖励函数在结构上具有相似性：它们都定义了可衡量的结果、阈值和例外，但往往只部分指定了制度意图。因此，LLM在RL训练中可能会利用这些规则中的漏洞，导致发现社会规则中的“漏洞”。为了系统性地研究这一现象，作者构建了一个名为SocioHack的沙箱环境，包含72个模拟社会场景（如税务、交通、选举等）。实验发现，在这些环境中，奖励黑客行为自然涌现，模型能够学会“黑掉”社会规则，生成在技术上合规但违背监管意图的策略。例如，模型可能找到避税策略或操纵选举结果的方法，而当前LLM的安全防护措施（如拒绝回答、内容过滤）只能提供有限的缓解。论文结论强调，在真实社会中迭代部署LLM需要更加谨慎地收集野外反馈，并呼吁开发新一代后训练范式，以确保模型在真实社会中的安全迭代。该研究对于AI安全、社会规则设计以及LLM部署具有重要启示。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了LLM在强化学习中可能发现并利用社会规则漏洞的风险，提醒安全从业者关注AI系统在真实世界部署时可能产生的意外负面影响。

items.title: Need to Know: Contextual-Integrity-Grounded Query Rewriting for Privacy-Conscious LLM Delegation
items.summary: As LLMs become increasingly woven into everyday workflows, user queries sent to cloud hosted LLMs routinely mix task-essential content with task non-essential sensitive disclosures, yet type based PII redaction is context agnostic and may raise two issues: over disclosing untyped sensitive context and over removing answer bearing spans. We recast privacy preserving query rewriting under Contextual Integrity: a span should be forwarded only if it is necessary for the task. We introduce DelegateCI-Bench, the first task based Contextual Integrity benchmark for privacy-conscious delegation, comprising 3,167 samples that combine high quality synthetic data spanning 11 tasks and 20 task types, WildChat based real user queries, and a medical challenge set with dense sensitive information. Building on this benchmark, we propose a CI-guided reinforcement learning framework that converts essential and non-essential sensitive spans into verifiable optimization signals, and train a query rewriter to preserve task critical information while suppressing unnecessary sensitive disclosure. Experiments show that our learned rewriter achieves the best privacy-utility tradeoff, achieving up to +10.1 average utility over on-device baselines.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对用户向云端LLM发送查询时的隐私泄露问题，提出了一种基于情境完整性（Contextual Integrity, CI）的查询重写方法。现有基于PII类型的脱敏方式忽略上下文，导致两类问题：过度暴露未标注的敏感上下文，或过度移除与回答相关的片段。作者将隐私保护的查询重写重新定义在CI框架下：只有任务必需的字段才应被转发。为此，他们构建了首个任务导向的CI基准测试DelegateCI-Bench，包含3,167个样本，涵盖11个任务和20种任务类型，包括高质量合成数据、基于WildChat的真实用户查询以及一个密集敏感信息的医疗挑战集。在此基础上，他们提出CI引导的强化学习框架，将必需和非必需敏感字段转化为可验证的优化信号，训练查询重写器在保留任务关键信息的同时抑制不必要的敏感披露。实验表明，该学习型重写器在隐私-效用权衡上达到最佳，在设备端基线基础上平均效用提升高达+10.1。该研究为隐私感知的LLM委托提供了新范式。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着LLM深度融入工作流，用户查询常混入非必要敏感信息，现有基于类型的脱敏效果不佳。本文提出基于情境完整性的查询重写，为解决隐私与效用矛盾提供了可量化的新思路。

items.title: Testing LLM Arithmetic Reasoning Generalization with Automatic Numeric-Remapping Attacks
items.summary: Large language models achieve strong performance on arithmetic reasoning benchmarks, and one common response to arithmetic brittleness is to delegate computation to code. Yet models are still often used in settings where they must reason directly from natural language, and trustworthy models should solve small-number arithmetic word problems without external tools. Prior work shows that LLMs are sensitive to numerical variation: a model may solve an original problem but fail on structurally similar variants requiring the same reasoning procedure with different numbers. We ask whether this fragility persists under a stricter setting involving small, schema-preserving numeric changes that retain the original reasoning program and avoid large-number stress tests. We introduce an automatic algorithm for generating numeric-remapping attacks on arithmetic word problems. Unlike template-based perturbation methods requiring manual schemas or constraints, our approach derives problem-specific symbolic representations, generates constrained numeric remappings, recomputes gold answers, and realizes transformed questions through deterministic edits guided by LLM-generated edit plans. Stage-wise validation and a high-confidence audit retain reliable attacks, making the pipeline scalable with limited human intervention. We evaluate DeepSeek-R1 (70B), Gemma4 (31B), and GPT-OSS (120B) on GSM8K, MAWPS, and MultiArith. On GSM8K, completed runs show conditional accuracy drops of 12.16 to 25.82 percentage points. MAWPS and MultiArith are far more stable, with most attacked accuracies near or above 98%. These results show that numeric-remapping robustness depends strongly on dataset structure: GSM8K remains sensitive even when reasoning programs are preserved and answers are recomputed, while shorter, more regular datasets are more robust.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在算术推理任务中对数值变化的鲁棒性问题。尽管LLM在基准测试中表现优异，但已有研究表明其对数值变化敏感：同一问题在不同数值下可能失败。现有方法多依赖模板或人工约束，局限性较大。为此，作者提出一种自动化的数值重映射攻击算法，能够生成保留原始推理程序的小规模数值变换，从而测试模型的泛化能力。该方法首先从问题中提取符号表示，生成受约束的数值重映射，重新计算正确答案，并通过LLM生成的编辑计划实现确定性变换。通过阶段验证和高置信度审计确保攻击可靠性，使管道可扩展。在GSM8K、MAWPS和MultiArith三个数据集上对DeepSeek-R1（70B）、Gemma4（31B）和GPT-OSS（120B）进行了评估。结果显示，在GSM8K上，已完成运行的模型条件准确率下降了12.16至25.82个百分点，而MAWPS和MultiArith则非常稳定，攻击后准确率仍接近或超过98%。这表明数值重映射鲁棒性高度依赖于数据集结构：GSM8K即使在保留推理程序和重计算答案的情况下仍然脆弱，而更短、更规整的数据集则更为鲁棒。该工作为评估LLM的算术推理泛化能力提供了一种新方法，对安全从业者理解LLM在数值推理任务中的局限性具有参考价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本方法揭示了LLM在算术推理中仍存在数值泛化脆弱性，即使使用小幅度、保留推理逻辑的数值变化也能导致准确率显著下降，对依赖LLM进行数学推理的应用场景构成潜在风险。

items.title: From Agent Traces to Trust: Evidence Tracing and Execution Provenance in LLM Agents
items.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly solve complex tasks by interacting with external tools, retrieval systems, memory modules, environments, and other agents. These capabilities expand agent autonomy, but also make agent behavior harder to verify, debug, and audit. Final-answer accuracy alone cannot explain how an output was produced, which evidence supported each claim, whether tool calls were justified, how memory influenced later decisions, or where execution failures originated. Evidence tracing and execution provenance address this gap by modeling how retrieved evidence, tool outputs, memory items, environment observations, intermediate claims, actions, and final answers are connected throughout agent execution. This survey provides a systematic review and conceptual framework for evidence tracing and execution provenance in LLM agents. We organize related work around a unified provenance perspective that connects retrieval grounding, claim support, tool-use safety, memory lineage, observability, debugging, audit, and recovery. We introduce a taxonomy covering trace sources, evidence and execution units, provenance relations, tracing granularity and timing, representation forms, and trust functions. We review key methodological directions, including provenance representation, evidence attribution, tool-use provenance, runtime guardrails, provenance-bearing memory, trace-based observability, and failure diagnosis. We also map existing benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation metrics to provenance-related capabilities, and discuss how evaluation can move from final-answer correctness toward process-level accountability. Finally, we outline open challenges, including unified trace schemas, claim-level and semantic provenance, provenance-aware safety mechanisms, realistic execution-trace benchmarks, recovery-oriented evaluation, and privacy-aware audit infrastructure.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过与外部工具、检索系统、记忆模块、环境及其他智能体交互来解决复杂任务。这种能力扩展了智能体的自主性，但也使其行为更难以验证、调试和审计。仅依靠最终答案的准确性无法解释输出是如何生成的、每个主张由哪些证据支持、工具调用是否合理、记忆如何影响后续决策以及执行失败的根源。证据追踪与执行溯源通过建模检索证据、工具输出、记忆项、环境观察、中间主张、动作和最终答案在智能体执行过程中的关联方式，弥补了这一空白。本文作为一篇综述，系统性地回顾了LLM智能体中证据追踪与执行溯源的相关工作，并提出了一个统一的概念框架。我们围绕统一的溯源视角组织相关工作，涵盖检索基础、主张支持、工具使用安全、记忆谱系、可观测性、调试、审计和恢复。我们提出了一种分类法，涵盖追踪源、证据与执行单元、溯源关系、追踪粒度与时机、表示形式以及信任函数。我们回顾了关键方法论方向，包括溯源表示、证据归因、工具使用溯源、运行时护栏、带溯源的记忆、基于追踪的可观测性以及故障诊断。此外，我们映射了现有基准、数据集和评估指标到溯源相关能力，并讨论了评估如何从最终答案正确性转向过程级可问责性。最后，我们概述了开放挑战，包括统一追踪模式、主张级和语义溯源、溯源感知的安全机制、真实的执行追踪基准、面向恢复的评估以及隐私感知的审计基础设施。

items.title: Black-box, Adaptive, Efficient, Transferable, Harmful, Applicable... Attacks Are All You Need to Break LLMs
items.summary: Accurately evaluating adversarial robustness is a longstanding challenge. A flawed attack design can inflate robustness estimates, making deployment risk assessment and defense comparison unreliable. Historically, standardized attacks such as AutoAttack have largely resolved this for image classifiers, providing a reliable evaluation baseline for systematic comparison across defenses. However, no equivalent exists for LLM jailbreak evaluation yet, where designing such an attack is considerably more difficult. A reliable attack must, among other things, be black-box compatible, applicable to arbitrary defense pipelines, and efficient, which no existing method jointly satisfies. We introduce Indirect Harm Optimization (IHO), a masked diffusion language model attacker trained via iterative preference optimization against a harmfulness judge, requiring only black-box access to the target. The same method can be used without modification as a strong adaptive attack on individual behaviors, or as an efficient amortized policy that transfers to held-out behaviors and unseen target models without fine-tuning. Even against layered defenses, such as a Circuit Breaker-trained model combined with an auxiliary detector, IHO improves attack success considerably over state-of-the-art approaches, without any defense-specific adaptation. Our results position IHO as a practical step toward the kind of standardized jailbreak evaluation that has improved reliability in the past. Code and models are available on GitHub and Hugging Face.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对大型语言模型（LLM）的对抗鲁棒性评估缺乏标准化基准的问题，提出了一种新的攻击方法——间接危害优化（Indirect Harm Optimization, IHO）。目前，LLM的越狱攻击评估存在诸多缺陷：攻击设计不完善会导致鲁棒性估计虚高，影响部署风险评估和防御比较。图像分类领域已有AutoAttack等标准化攻击，但LLM领域尚无类似方法，主要因为设计一个同时满足黑盒兼容、适用于任意防御管线、且高效的攻击极具挑战。IHO利用掩码扩散语言模型，通过迭代偏好优化来训练攻击者，仅需对目标模型进行黑盒访问。该方法无需修改即可作为针对个体行为的强自适应攻击，或作为高效的摊销策略迁移到未见的行文和未知目标模型，且无需微调。即使面对分层防御（如Circuit Breaker训练模型结合辅助检测器），IHO在不进行防御特定适配的情况下，攻击成功率也显著优于现有方法。论文将IHO定位为迈向标准化LLM越狱评估的实用步骤，有助于提升未来鲁棒性评估的可靠性。代码和模型已在GitHub和Hugging Face公开。
